title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. signs with Vikings
items.desc: Odell Beckham Jr. signed with the Vikings on Wednesday.
items.impact: Released by the Giants last week, Beckham will join the Vikings' practice squad this week. It seems likely that the veteran will be added to the active roster at some point soon, but his role with the Vikings' offense is up in the air at the moment.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chase McLaughlin (hip/groin) active at Wednesday's practice
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin (hip/groin) took part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: McLaughlin did not practice on Tuesday, but he was back on Wednesday. The Buccaneers have not added another kicker this week, so it appears the team is not too concerned about McLaughlin's status for Thursday's game.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) misses practice again Wednesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) sat out Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: With the Buccaneers playing Thursday night, Mayfield is on track to miss a second straight game due to a thumb injury, as he has not practiced this week. Jalon Daniels is in line to start at QB once again.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Nate Lynn added to Jets roster
items.desc: Nate Lynn was added to the Jets' active roster on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lynn has been on the practice squad, but he'll now provide depth on the defensive front for the Jets with Braiden McGregor (pectoral) out for the season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Carl Lawson signs with Colts
items.desc: Carl Lawson signed a contract to join the Colts' practice squad Wednesday.
items.impact: With Arden Key (hamstring) down for a few weeks, the Colts added to their pass-rush depth by bringing in Lawson. The veteran played just one game last season, but Lawson is just two years removed from a five-sack campaign and has 32 over 90 career NFL games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Charles Omenihu (groin) without timetable to return
items.desc: Commanders DE Charles Omenihu is without a clear timetable to return.
items.impact: Omenihu is week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) without timetable to return
items.desc: Terry McLaurin does not hold a clear timetable to return.
items.impact: McLaurin sat out last week's loss against the Colts. It appears he could miss another game. He is week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) to return to practice this week
items.desc: Rachaad White will practice this week.
items.impact: White sat out last week's game against the Colts. Austin Ekeler has since signed with the team where he took over a role in the passing game in his debut with Washington. It could be White and Ekeler splitting the passing down role when they're both healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion) will practice this week
items.desc: Sam Cosmi will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Cosmi did not travel with the team to London last week. He is hopeful to return in Week 5.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Cross (illness) to practice this week
items.desc: Nick Cross will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Cross did not travel with the team to London last week. He is hopeful to return in Week 5.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) to practice this week
items.desc: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will practice this week.
items.impact: Daniels remains hopeful to return in Week 5. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.title: Nate Hobbs (groin) 'getting close'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Upton Stout (shoulder) day-to-day

items.impact: The status of Stout is up in the air heading into Week 5.
